rationale: John brings deep cloud infrastructure and AI/ML ops expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) paired with a conviction that cloud-native foundations are essential for enterprise AI adoption, while Dev is building Gooey.AI—a low-code AI orchestration platform that sits exactly at that infrastructure layer. Dev is actively hiring software engineers and John's background in systems architecture, combined with his operational leadership at Cloudfitters and community-building track record at Code and Coffee, could offer valuable perspective on scaling a developer-tools platform.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Dev Aggarwal — John's deep expertise in cloud infrastructure and AI/ML operations complements Dev's work scaling Gooey.AI's low-code orchestration platform, and Dev's team is hiring.
